limitations: Scores assess the browser implementation provisionally; related normal, enlarged, transition and listed state variants are grouped in each entry.
Runtime claims are supplied evidence, not independently rerun observations; still images cannot establish interaction behavior or motion quality.
For each item, A and F are the means of their applicable three dimensions and overall is 0.4A + 0.6F rounded to one decimal; null denotes genuinely inapplicable dimensions.
The authorized threshold is not met: several screen and component A or F means remain below 9.
No definite hard-gate failure is established by this deck; cropped content at a scroll boundary does not by itself prove an unreachable control.
Physical iPhone, VoiceOver, native text enlargement, keyboard, speech, haptics, OS sharing and real payment behavior remain unverified.
Static transition frames show visual consistency but cannot independently establish effortless temporal continuity.
Fixture questions, legacy repeated text, synthetic sources and old confidence labels do not establish production model quality or predictive accuracy.
Circles evidence covers offline presentation only, and controlled consent evidence does not establish an actual remote-provider integration.
No representative novice study or full native 9/10 certification is supported.
topFixes: Improve enlarged-layout task proximity on birth details, plans, sharing and history so the next action appears sooner without reducing text size.
Keep consent disclosure and decision controls more closely grouped at 200%.
Clarify unavailable omen status and the age-confirmation fallback limits.
Standardize result secondary-action alignment and distinguish disclosure from navigation labels.
Adapt Sky instructions to its enlarged text controls and correct the visible lowercase zodiac display.
Complete physical keyboard, speech and assistive-technology verification after the remaining browser refinements.
